Guidance & outlook: Based on publicly available FY 2025-26 financial data, consolidated total revenue increased to approximately ₹115.58 crore from ₹44.97 crore in FY 2024-25, representing growth of approximately 157%.
ONECLICK LOGISTICS INDIA LIMITED 4th ANNUAL REPORT (2025-2026) EPS was reported at approximately ₹5.54 for FY 2025-26 compared with ₹5.89 for FY 2024-25.

Strategic and Corporate Developments during / after FY 2025-26 FY 2025-26: During the financial year 2025-26, the Company undertook a preferential issue of 19,89,363 equity shares of face value ₹10 each at an issue price of ₹168 per equity share, aggregating to approximately ₹33.42 crore.
Growth & demand: The consolidated profit before tax stood at ₹331.37 lakhs, as against ₹283.07 lakhs in the previous year, registering a growth of approximately 17.06%.

Evolving B2C demand and consumption trends Growth in e-commerce, digital payments and penetration into Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets continues to support demand for faster, reliable and cost-efficient logistics.

Risks and Concerns Freight rates, carrier charges, fuel-linked costs and customer pricing pressure may affect margins.
Capex & expansion: Acquisition of Winners Freight Management India Private Limited On July 10, 2026, the Company acquired 60% of the equity share capital of Winners Freight Management India Private Limited for a total cash consideration of ₹5.16 crore.

Acquisition of Indispice Dehydration Private Limited: During the year, the Company initially acquired 50% of the equity share capital of Indispice Dehydration Private Limited for a consideration of ₹27 crore.
Acquisition of Associate Company: During the year, the Company acquired a 46.31% equity stake in Shree Siddhi Vinayak Express Movers Private Limited.
